intro.text: I deliver tacos, secrets, and occasionally fugitives. Depends on the tip.
intro.speaker: Louis

choices.text: Tell me about the delivery route
I need help with a heist

route_info.text: The city has three kinds of doors: locked, unlocked, and delivery entrance. I know all the delivery entrances. The Taco Bell on 5th? Back door's busted. Has been for months. Management doesn't care because the rats keep the health inspector away.
route_info.speaker: Louis

rats_story.text: Big ones. I named the biggest one 'Manager' because he's been there longer than the actual manager. Don't worry, they only come out after midnight. Which, coincidentally, is when the safe gets restocked.
rats_story.speaker: Louis

heist_help.text: Crunchwrap, no witnesses? What do you need? I can get you floor plans, shift schedules, and the manager's embarrassing Spotify playlist. Not sure which is more useful.
heist_help.speaker: Louis

heist_plans.text: Done. I drew them on a napkin. It's accurate, I promise. The napkin is also laminated because I've been carrying it for three weeks waiting for you to ask.
heist_plans.speaker: Louis

louis_confession.text: Let's just say the manager shorted me on hot sauce one too many times. I'm not petty. I'm... invested. In justice. And also revenge. But mostly justice.
louis_confession.speaker: Louis

intel_check.text: Ooh, spending that intel? I like a customer who knows the value of information. What do you want to know?
intel_check.speaker: Louis

new_routes.text: The jazz club on Meridian? They get their liquor through a back alley. No cameras. No guards after 2 AM. Just a very sleepy delivery guy who owes me a favor.
new_routes.speaker: Louis

watchers.text: There's a private investigator asking questions. Goes by 'The Eye.' Real creative. He's been sniffing around the taco drop zone. Might want to be careful.
watchers.speaker: Louis

goodbye.text: Stay safe out there. And tip your delivery drivers.
goodbye.speaker: Louis

post_mission.text: Heard you pulled it off. The Crunchwrap Caper. That's what I'm calling it. Don't argue. I've already told three people.
post_mission.speaker: Louis

louis_post_okay.text: Okay? You stole a diamond shaped like a Crunchwrap. That's not 'okay.' That's art.
louis_post_okay.speaker: Louis

louis_post_name.text: Too late. It's trending. Well, it's trending in my group chat. Same thing.
louis_post_name.speaker: Louis
